# WhiteMagic

> Local-first memory and session continuity for coding agents, over MCP. Rust, MIT, no telemetry, no cloud service. Records what matters, finds it after restart, and carries decisions into the next session — on your machine.

WhiteMagic gives an AI coding agent durable project memory: explicit MCP routes, lexical search without an external model, session record/replay, cross-session continuity, backup/verify/restore, and Linux Landlock containment. Trusted, local, single-user operation. Truthful degradation when optional models are unavailable.

## Install

One-line installer (resolves the latest release, verifies the checksum):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lbailey94/whitemagic/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

Or download the binary from the [latest release](https://github.com/lbailey94/whitemagic/releases), verify with `sha256sum -c`, and move it to `~/.local/bin/wm`.

## Connect an MCP client

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "whitemagic": {
      "command": "wm",
      "args": ["serve", "--profile", "curated"]
    }
  }
}
```

The server speaks stdio JSON-RPC and exposes a single `wm` meta-tool; explicit routing is the dependable contract.

## Verify

```bash
wm --version   # wm 9.1.3
wm doctor      # environment health check
```

- [PRIVACY_POLICY.md](https://github.com/lbailey94/whitemagic/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md) — no telemetry; your store never leaves the device.

- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/lbailey94/whitemagic/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) — release history.
